name: Gateborn Colossus
lore: A giant malformed guardian grown around unstable Gate stone. It is not a Deity and has no civilization; it is a defensive catastrophe.
visualDescription: Massive stone-black creature with gateway ribs, glowing fracture-core, many broken arch fragments embedded in its shoulders.
mapBehavior: Controls central objectives and forces Deities to split pressure.

scaling.campaign: Fixed mission bands; old wins should become easier as Divine Level and gear rise.
Fixed mission bands; old wins should become easier as Deity level and gear rise.
scaling.eliteRemix: +12% hp, +10% damage, +1 mechanic layer, +2 tactical AI priority.
scaling.endgame: Dynamic scaling is capped at player effective level +8; adds mechanics before raw hp.
scaling.levelFormula: hp = baseHp * (1 + 0.045 * missionLevel); damage = baseDamage * (1 + 0.035 * missionLevel), capped by tier budget

aiProfile.counterplayWindow: Every major action has a telegraph or setup turn unless spawned as a minor swarmer.

balanceNotes: Harder solo tuning: Major BRUTE pressures one active deity through behavior first, stats second; threatWeight 2.0 controls encounter budgets.
